verdict.rationale: Canny is a hosted SaaS, so headless automation would come through programmatic interfaces. The pack only shows an API Reference page (title only) and an MCP server. The MCP server is pitched for interactive LLM clients with a secure sign-in ("no API keys"), plus a vague mention of running agents that act on feedback, which suggests automation is possible but gives no evidence of non-interactive or CI use. Missing for 10: documented API authentication for unattended/CI use, a CLI or CI integration, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), headless MCP auth such as tokens, and any hands-on corroboration.
